test_crosstab_single: test the crosstab function with a single row and column argument to produce a count table
test_crosstab_multiple: test the crosstab function with multiple column arrays to produce a multi-level column cross-tabulation
test_crosstab_normalize: test the crosstab function with normalize parameter to compute row, column, or all percentages
test_crosstab_margins: test the crosstab function with margins=True to add row and column totals with custom margin names
test_crosstab_with_categorical_columns: test the crosstab function with categorical columns to preserve category order in the result
